output.summary: A small creeping annual or perennial plant of unspecified native origin, it carpets shallow water and muddy ground near ponds, ditches and streams. Its shiny, ivy-shaped leaves lack the finely divided submerged leaves of other water crowfoots, while its white flowers have yellow bases.
output.edibilityNote: Known to cause gastrointestinal distress; it was also sometimes used to treat skin conditions and wounds.
